_doc: Collections and the closed state (docs/city_interiors.md "Collections", "Closed"). collections: {"<set>": {"title": key, "pieces": [...]}} (pieces left out: every piece something in town gives); an act, a line or a rule gives a stamp with "collect": "<set>/<piece>" (a line "<set>/*": the line key's last part; a rule "{plot}": the thing's plot). closed_by: {"<plot id | building type | plot kind>": {"<thing kind> | *": "<act id or line key>"}}: what a thing says while its plot is shut (a rule's or an act's own "closed" wins).
